R552.note: HTML-escapes the Referer before writing; dropping format() means percent-specifiers are no longer expanded, but that is stated plainly and breaks no legitimate caller (leftover unused obj array is cosmetic).

R553.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES on both concatenated fields closes the sink and changes nothing else.

R554.note: Build FAIL (UnknownIdentifierException lives in DynamicExpresso.Exceptions and is not imported), and the added character allowlist rejects formulas the original accepted - anything with a comma, comparison operator or string literal.

R555.note: Argument list with shell=False plus a fullmatch on the alphanumeric format the docstring already documents; verified in a scratch dir that CPython 3.13 does launch a .bat with shell=False and quotes the argument, so the endpoint still works.

R556.note: Escapes the POST sink and the two GET echoes with htmlspecialchars; the added null-coalesce on note is stated and rejects nothing.

R557.note: CR/LF and '>' rejection closes the RCPT injection, but the added strict email regex rejects addresses the original accepted (user@localhost, quoted local parts, internationalised domains).

R558.note: Binding the algorithm via new Key(publicKey, 'RS256') closes algorithm confusion and the required 6.x upgrade is stated; the dropped HS256 branch could never have verified legitimately since only the RSA public key was ever passed.

R559.note: escapeshellarg on host is the right API for this sink and leaves valid hostnames untouched; residual option injection (a host beginning with a dash still reaches ping as a flag) is unaddressed but minor.

R560.note: RFC 4515 escaping with backslash handled first is correct, but the silent falsy guard turns a username of "0" into the filter (uid=) instead of (uid=0).

R561.note: Adds the UPLOAD_ERR_OK check before finfo and move and nothing else; successful uploads behave exactly as before.

R562.note: Comparing payloadLength against frameBuffer.size() before the memcpy closes the over-read using the function's existing false return; valid lengths still copy identically.

R563.note: Standard erase-returns-iterator idiom; removes every completed task, preserves order, skips no element.

R564.note: UPLOAD_ERR_OK check closes the finding; the extra fileinfo guard and the type-derived extension appended to the stored filename change the on-disk artifact but are stated in detail and block no legitimate upload.

R565.note: Generic 500 body with the wrapped detail moved to log.Printf; status code and success path unchanged.

R566.note: Server-side IsInRole("Admin") from GetAuthenticationStateAsync inside the handler closes the direct-invocation path; only the unauthorized branch changes behaviour.

R567.note: Reproduced in a scratch dir on Node v24: execFile on a .bat without shell throws spawn EINVAL, so no report is generated for any caller, while the write-up asserts the .bat receives the argument as %1 normally.
